LICENSE and LICENSE-3RD-PARTY are copied verbatim from the same upstream
checkout. They include the Quiet, liquid-dsp, Emscripten and Jansson terms.
The compiled JavaScript uses asm.js with its external .mem data file.

Forward error correction

This binary incorporates quiet/libcorrect's BSD-3-Clause compatibility shim.
For example, the generated init_rs_char function checks 8-bit symbols and
initializes the 28-byte reed_solomon_shim with its padded length, message
length, decoder object and two scratch buffers, as in:
https://github.com/quiet/libcorrect/blob/f5a28c74fba7a99736fe49d3a5243eca29517ae9/src/fec_shim.c
LICENSE-libcorrect contains that project's copyright and full license.
The pinned release's older README also discusses dynamically loading Phil
Karn's LGPL libfec.js. PhotoPass does not distribute or load that library.

PhotoPass supplies modem-worker.js, capture-worklet.js and sound-modem.js.
They select audible-7k-channel-0 at 9,200 Hz with CRC-32, rate-1/2
constraint-length-9 convolutional coding and outer Reed–Solomon coding, raise
the permitted binary packet size to 1,200 bytes, normalize speaker output and
precede each burst with a tapered 40 ms tone to wake the audio route.
